newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Foreigners bought $140 million of Russian T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners bought $140 million of Russian T-bills.

text.p: Non-residents bought about $140 million worth of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills at two auctions on Wednesday, a central bank official said.
Non-residents were allowed to buy up to 35 percent nominal of a seven trillion roubles issue and 10 percent nominal of 3.50 trillion roubles issue.
Konstantin Korishchenko, head of open market operations at the central bank, told Reuters it would be difficult to get an exact picture of non-resident's holdings of T-bills.
This is because non-resident transactions run through both the government securities and foreign exchange markets, and foreigners would also be able to buy T-bills in the secondary market.
The central bank widened access to the government securities market to foreigners earlier this month.
